pageProps.title: Suspicious People
pageProps.review: Keigo Higashino's novel Suspicious People delves sharply into the dark desires and prejudices of humans hidden in ordinary daily life through seven short stories, posing heavy questions about truth and trust.
pageProps.description: How weak and dangerous can the human heart be?
pageProps.content:
## Review Consisting of a total of seven short stories, it goes beyond the simple framework of ```finding the culprit``` and delves into the dark desires of humans hidden in ordinary daily life. As the title suggests, in a situation where all characters look suspicious, the reader is left questioning what is true and who to trust.
Every character has suspicious circumstances and motives. In other words, naturally everyone is a suspect.
Readers realize how easily they fall into prejudice and make hasty judgments.
On what basis do you judge and trust others?
